sentence_stem: The teacher gave us a very difficult test, so
correct_completion: we had to study hard for it.
full_sentence: The teacher gave us a very difficult test, so we had to study hard for it.
acceptable_variants: we had to revise a lot for it.
we spent the whole weekend studying.

options.text: we went to the cinema on Friday.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result of the first clause. Going to the cinema does not follow logically from a difficult test.

options.text: the test was easy for everyone.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which describes the test as difficult, and it gives no result.

options.text: we had to study hard for it.
but we did not study at all.
options.why_wrong: 'But' expresses contrast, while the stem with 'so' needs a result that follows from the difficulty.

explanation: 'So' introduces the result of the first clause. The completion must show what follows logically from a very difficult test.
translation: O professor nos deu uma prova muito difícil, então tivemos que estudar muito para ela.
